title: Normalisation and decomposition
brief: Derive candidate keys from declared dependencies and choose lossless, dependency-preserving decompositions where possible. Own closure, synthesis, 3NF versus BCNF, multivalued and join dependencies, and higher normal forms. The parent develops practical diagnoses and simple reconstruction examples.

neighbouring_ownership.data-modelling: Owns introductory anomalies, useful normal forms and the initial tags/suppliers and ternary offer contrasts.
